title: What are these errors?
summary: When your application calls an LLM API, the provider responds with an HTTP status code. These codes help identify the failure. Two important categories: - HTTP 429 — Too many requests or quota/rate-limit related rejection. - HTTP 5xx — Server-side or upstream service failures.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
When your application calls an LLM API, the provider responds with an HTTP status code.

These codes help identify the failure.

Two important categories:

- HTTP 429 — Too many requests or quota/rate-limit related rejection.
- HTTP 5xx — Server-side or upstream service failures.
